rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for paint as a coating substance.

example.english: We bought several buckets of paint because we’re renovating the house tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋聽日要幫間屋翻新，所以買咗幾桶油漆。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 bong1 gaan1 uk1 faan1 san1 so2 ji5 maai5 zo2 gei2 tung2 jau4 cat1

rows.note: Use this shorter form when the context clearly shows that 油 means paint rather than oil.

example.english: This paint dries quickly and is perfect for a wooden door.
example.traditional: 呢隻油乾得快，啱晒木門。
example.jyutping: nei1 zek3 jau4 gon1 dak1 faai3 ngaam1 saai3 muk6 mun4

rows.note: Use 油 when applying paint or a coating to a surface such as a wall.

example.english: We need to paint the wall at home tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋聽日要油返屋企道牆。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 jau4 faan1 uk1 kei2 dou6 coeng4

rows.note: Use 畫 as the all-purpose verb for creating a picture or image.

example.english: I like to paint landscapes in watercolour most.
example.traditional: 我最鍾意用水彩畫風景。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 jung6 seoi2 coi2 waa2 fung1 ging2

rows.note: Use 畫畫 when talking about practising or spending time doing painting as an activity.

example.english: I paint at home whenever I have free time.
example.traditional: 我得閒就會喺屋企畫畫。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dak1 haan4 zau6 wui5 hai2 uk1 kei2 waa2 waa2

rows.note: Use 描繪 when depicting someone or something in a particular way, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: This book helps paint a picture of life in postwar Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢本書描繪咗戰後香港嘅生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 miu4 kui2 zo2 zin3 hau6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 sang1 wut6
